title: Evaluation of Predictive Reliability to Foster Trust in Artificial Intelligence. A case study in Multiple Sclerosis.
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on evaluating the predictive reliability of machine learning models in a medical context, specifically for Multiple Sclerosis, using techniques like autoencoders for out-of-distribution detection.
